request.title: Prove Printed.sLocalSmoothMass_eq_sharp_real_false ((12.4.1.22), p. 518)
request.body:
Closes #5577

Proves `Printed.sLocalSmoothMass_eq_sharp_real_false` in `RiemannMasullo/Ch12_TraceGeometric/Sec4_Printed.lean` (refutation of (12.4.1.22), p. 518).

Counterexample as in the docstring: L = L' = 1, ε = 1/2, ρ = σ the `ContDiffBump` at 0 with radii 1/2 and 1, and f the `ContDiffBump` at 1 with radii 1/32 and 1/16 (support (15/16, 17/16)). On the square [-1,1]² the phase satisfies |2π(g⁻¹−1)xu| ≤ 2π/15 < π/2, so the kernel m is nonnegative there and strictly positive on the edge x = 1. The cutoff vanishes at x = 1, so the smooth mass is strictly smaller than the sharp mass.

Structure: three `private theorem`s directly above the refutation (positivity of the integral of a continuous function over an interval, the abstract strict comparison for a continuous kernel and cutoff, and the cosine bound). Continuity of m comes from `continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous` after replacing g by max g (1/2), which agrees with g on the support of f.

Checks run:
- `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch12_TraceGeometric.Sec4_Printed`: the module builds in 3.3 s; the only remaining `sorry` is the untouched `Printed.sLocalProductCutoff_preservesSchwartzBruhat_false` (#5576).
- `#print axioms RiemannMasullo.Printed.sLocalSmoothMass_eq_sharp_real_false` (on a scratch copy with the same statement): `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- `scripts/signatures.sh --compare` on this module before and after: no changes.
- `lake build` (full): success. `scripts/lint.sh`: ok.
